statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent episodes of palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat without a clear precipitating factor.
There is a need for extended rhythm correlation.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring was ordered to capture potential arrhythmic events over a prolonged monitoring period.
The service was billed under CPT code 93229.
The service was billed under diagnosis codes I49.9 and R00.2.
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197.
The denial was because required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered.
Coverage for this diagnostic procedure mandates advance approval.
